intro.zh: 吕宋岛是菲律宾面积最大、人口最多的岛，位于群岛北部，是全国的政治和经济中心，首都马尼拉和人口最多的奎松市都在岛上。2024 年人口约 64.3 百万，超过全国一半，是世界人口第 4 多的岛。岛上既有火山、梯田和高山，也有城市古迹，旅游资源极其丰富。
intro.en: Luzon is the largest and most populous island of the Philippines and the country's economic and political centre, home to the capital Manila and to Quezon City. With 64.3 million people in 2024, more than half of the national population, it is the 4th most populous island in the world. Volcanoes, rice terraces, mountains and colonial landmarks give it an enormous range of places to visit.

intro.zh: 宿务岛是中米沙鄢的核心，宿务省由主岛和周围 167 个小岛组成。首府宿务市号称“南方女王城”，是菲律宾最古老的城市和第一个首都，大宿务都会区是全国第三大都会区。岛上有麦哲伦十字架、圣佩德罗堡等古迹，南部有卡瓦山瀑布、奥斯梅纳峰和莫阿尔博阿尔潜水区。
intro.en: Cebu is the heart of Central Visayas; the province consists of the main island and 167 surrounding islands and islets. Cebu City, the "Queen City of the South", is the oldest city and first capital of the Philippines, and Metro Cebu is the country's third-largest metropolitan area. Historic sites such as Magellan's Cross and Fort San Pedro sit in the city, while the south offers Kawasan Falls, Osmeña Peak and the reefs of Moalboal.

name.zh: 莫阿尔博阿尔沙丁鱼风暴潜点

intro.zh: 棉兰老岛是菲律宾第二大岛，仅次于吕宋，也是世界人口第七多的岛，2020 年人口 26,252,442 人。岛上分为三宝颜半岛、北棉兰老、卡拉加、达沃、南哥苏萨将和邦萨摩洛自治区六个大区，达沃市是最大城市。这里有全国最高峰阿波山、清澈的魔幻河和众多瀑布湖泊。
intro.en: Mindanao is the second-largest island in the Philippines after Luzon and the seventh most populous island in the world, with 26,252,442 people in 2020. It is divided into six regions, from the Zamboanga Peninsula to Davao and the autonomous Bangsamoro region, and Davao City is its biggest city. It is home to Mount Apo, the country's highest peak, as well as clear rivers, waterfalls and highland lakes.

name.zh: 玛丽亚·克里斯蒂娜瀑布

intro.zh: 内格罗斯岛是菲律宾第四大、人口第三多的岛，陆地面积 13,309 平方公里，2024 年人口 4,797,302 人。岛南部沿海被认定为“珊瑚三角区”海洋生物多样性最重要的地区之一。岛上有活火山坎拉翁火山、双子湖自然公园和不少瀑布，西部的巴科洛德一带还有著名的“废墟”庄园遗址。
intro.en: Negros is the fourth-largest and third most populous island in the Philippines, with 13,309 square kilometres of land and 4,797,302 people in 2024. The coastal zone of its south is recognised as one of the most important areas for marine biodiversity in the Coral Triangle. Inland rise the active Kanlaon Volcano, the Twin Lakes of Balinsasayao and many waterfalls, while near Bacolod stands the well-known mansion ruin called The Ruins.

name.zh: 巴林萨萨尧双子湖自然公园

intro.zh: 长滩岛位于班乃岛西北岸外约 0.8 公里，陆地面积约 10.32 平方公里，归阿克兰省马莱镇的三个村管辖，2020 年人口 37,802 人。这里以细白沙滩闻名，长年位列世界最佳海岛榜单：2012 年被《Travel + Leisure》评为世界最佳岛屿。岛上度假村、潜水店和餐厅密布，是菲律宾名气最大的海岛度假地。
intro.en: Boracay lies about 0.8 kilometres off the northwest coast of Panay. Its 10.32 square kilometres fall under three barangays of Malay, Aklan, and 37,802 people lived there in 2020. Famous for its powdery white sand, it has topped many best-island lists, including Travel + Leisure's Best Island in the World in 2012, and its shore is lined with resorts, dive shops and restaurants.

intro.zh: 班乃岛是菲律宾第六大、人口第四多的岛，陆地面积 12,011 平方公里，2024 年人口 4,669,037 人，最大城市是伊洛伊洛市。岛呈三角形，宽约 160 公里，分为阿克兰、安蒂克、卡皮斯和伊洛伊洛四省，都属西米沙鄢大区。岛上有世界遗产米亚高教堂、原始森林国家公园和海边红树林生态园。
intro.en: Panay is the sixth-largest and fourth most populous island in the Philippines, with 12,011 square kilometres of land and 4,669,037 people in 2024; Iloilo City is its largest settlement. The triangular island is about 160 kilometres across and divided into the provinces of Aklan, Antique, Capiz and Iloilo in Western Visayas. Sights include the baroque Miagao Church, forested national parks and mangrove eco-parks.

name.zh: 布拉博格—普蒂安国家公园
马德哈阿斯山顶观景点

intro.zh: 巴拉望岛是巴拉望省最大的岛，按面积是全国第五大岛，2024 年人口 1,023,849 人。西北岸濒临南中国海东部的巴拉望水道，东南岸是苏禄海北缘。岛上大部分地区保持着传统风貌，丛林山地、野生动物和白沙滩吸引大量游客，世界遗产普林塞萨港地下河就在这里。
intro.en: Palawan is the largest island of Palawan province and the fifth-largest island of the country, with 1,023,849 people in 2024. Its northwest coast faces the Palawan Passage in the eastern South China Sea, while the southeast forms the northern edge of the Sulu Sea. Much of the island remains traditional, and its wildlife, jungle-clad mountains and white beaches, including the Puerto Princesa Underground River, attract many tourists.

name.zh: 普林塞萨港地下河国家公园
name.en: Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park

intro.zh: 莱特岛位于米沙鄢群岛，是菲律宾第八大、人口第六多的岛，2020 年人口 2,626,970 人。岛上居民多以务农为生，稻米和玉米是主粮，也种椰子、蕉麻和甘蔗。行政上分为莱特省和南莱特省，主要城市是东岸的塔克洛班和西岸的奥尔莫克。二战时麦克阿瑟在此登陆，留有纪念公园。
intro.en: Leyte, in the Visayas, is the eighth-largest and sixth most populous island in the Philippines, with 2,626,970 people in 2020. Most residents farm rice and corn, with coconuts, abaca and sugarcane as cash crops. The island is split into Leyte and Southern Leyte provinces, and its main cities are Tacloban on the east coast and Ormoc on the west. The MacArthur landing site of World War II is remembered in a national park.

name.zh: 麦克阿瑟登陆纪念公园
夸普尼特—巴林萨萨尧国家公园

intro.zh: 萨马尔岛位于达沃湾，与它南边的小岛塔利库德岛一起组成“萨马尔岛花园市”，属北达沃省，2024 年人口 119,701 人。岛离棉兰老岛上的达沃市只有 2 公里，是大达沃都会区的一部分，也是达沃人最常去的海滩度假地，沿岸度假村和潜水点密布，岛上还有著名的蝙蝠洞保护区。
intro.en: Samal Island lies in the Davao Gulf and, together with the smaller Talikud Island to its south, forms the Island Garden City of Samal in Davao del Norte, home to 119,701 people in 2024. Only 2 kilometres from Davao City on mainland Mindanao and part of Metro Davao, it is the city's favourite beach getaway, lined with resorts and dive spots, and home to a famous bat cave sanctuary.

intro.zh: 薄荷省由薄荷岛和周围 75 个小岛组成，位于中米沙鄢，首府塔比拉兰。薄荷岛陆地面积 4,821 平方公里、海岸线长 261 公里，是全国第十大岛。最著名的景点是巧克力山——成片褐色的石灰岩圆丘；此外还有洛博克河游船、眼镜猴和古老的石头教堂，西南的邦劳岛则以潜水出名。
intro.en: Bohol province consists of the island itself and 75 minor surrounding islands in Central Visayas, with Tagbilaran as its capital. With 4,821 square kilometres of land and a 261-kilometre coastline, Bohol is the tenth-largest island in the country. Its most famous attraction is the Chocolate Hills, a sea of brown limestone mounds, alongside river cruises on the Loboc, tarsiers and old stone churches; Panglao to the southwest is known for diving.

name.zh: 拉惹西卡图纳保护景观区

intro.zh: 邦劳岛位于保和海北部、薄荷岛西南侧，属中米沙鄢地区，与薄荷岛之间有桥相连。岛南的阿罗娜海滩是主要度假区，周边珊瑚礁和巴里卡萨岛等潜点让这里成为菲律宾著名的潜水胜地；岛内还有带地下水潭的溶洞，海边度假村与小餐馆一应俱全。
intro.en: Panglao is an island in the northern Bohol Sea, in the Central Visayas, lying just southwest of Bohol and linked to it by bridges. Alona Beach on its south shore is the main resort strip, and nearby reefs and dive sites such as Balicasag have made it one of the country's well-known diving areas. Inland there is a limestone cave with an underground pool, and beach resorts and cafés are everywhere.

intro.zh: 锡亚高岛是菲律宾海上一座泪滴形的岛，位于塔克洛班东南 196 公里，陆地面积约 437 平方公里，属北苏里高省，下辖八个镇。东岸平直，海岸线上礁石、小岬角和白沙滩相间。它被称为“菲律宾冲浪之都”，2021 年获《康泰纳仕旅行者》读者票选亚洲最佳岛屿。
intro.en: Siargao is a tear-drop shaped island in the Philippine Sea, 196 kilometres southeast of Tacloban, with a land area of about 437 square kilometres. Part of Surigao del Norte, it has eight municipalities. Its coast is a string of reefs, small points and white sandy beaches. Known as the surfing capital of the Philippines, it was voted Best Island in Asia by Condé Nast Traveler readers in 2021.

intro.zh: 麦克坦岛就在宿务岛以东几公里，中间隔着麦克坦海峡，如今有宿务—科尔多瓦跨海高速、麦克坦—曼达韦大桥和马塞洛·费尔南大桥三座桥相连。全岛分属拉普拉普市和科尔多瓦镇，面积约 65 平方公里，2024 年人口 526,620 人，是全国人口最稠密的岛。麦克坦—宿务国际机场也在岛上，海边度假村林立。
intro.en: Mactan lies a few kilometres east of Cebu across the Mactan Channel, now spanned by three bridges: the Cebu–Cordova Link Expressway, the Mactan–Mandaue Bridge and the Marcelo Fernan Bridge. Split between Lapu-Lapu City and Cordova, the island covers some 65 square kilometres and had 526,620 residents in 2024, making it the most densely populated island in the country. Mactan–Cebu International Airport is here too.

name.zh: 宿务—科尔多瓦跨海高速

intro.zh: 萨马岛是菲律宾第三大岛，2024 年人口 1,924,651 人，位于东米沙鄢大区。自 1965 年起分为西萨马、北萨马和东萨马三省。居民以瓦赖人为主，多信奉天主教。1521 年 3 月 16 日麦哲伦船队首次望见这座岛。岛上森林茂密，有索霍顿天然石桥国家公园和萨马岛自然公园等喀斯特溶洞景观。
intro.en: Samar is the third-largest island in the Philippines, with 1,924,651 people in 2024, in the Eastern Visayas region. Since 1965 it has been divided into Samar, Northern Samar and Eastern Samar provinces. Its people are mainly Waray and Roman Catholic, and Magellan's expedition first sighted it on March 16, 1521. Dense forests hide karst landscapes such as the Sohoton Natural Bridge and the Samar Island Natural Park.

name.zh: 索霍顿天然石桥国家公园

intro.zh: 布桑加岛是巴拉望省卡拉棉群岛中最大的岛，也是全省仅次于巴拉望本岛的第二大岛，位于民都洛和巴拉望之间。西三分之一属布桑加镇，东三分之二属科隆镇。1944 年 9 月 24 日美军在科隆湾击沉多艘日本船，这些二战沉船让这里成为世界知名的沉船潜水地。
intro.en: Busuanga is the largest island of the Calamian Group and the second-largest in Palawan province, lying halfway between Mindoro and Palawan. Its western third belongs to the municipality of Busuanga and the rest to Coron. On September 24, 1944, American aircraft sank a fleet of Japanese ships in Coron Bay, and those World War II wrecks have made the area a world-famous wreck-diving destination.

intro.zh: 马林杜克是位于菲律宾西南他加禄大区的岛省，首府博阿克。它北临塔亚巴斯湾、南接锡布延海，西邻民都洛、北望奎松省邦多克半岛。部分“佛得岛水道”——被誉为世界海洋生物多样性中心——也在其海域。2013 年被评为全国最和平的省份，每年圣周的莫里奥内斯节历史悠久。
intro.en: Marinduque is an island province in the Southwestern Tagalog Region, with Boac as its capital. It lies between Tayabas Bay to the north and the Sibuyan Sea to the south, east of Mindoro and west of the Bondoc Peninsula. Part of the Verde Island Passage, regarded as a centre of marine biodiversity, lies in its waters. Ranked the country's most peaceful province in 2013, it is also home to one of the oldest religious festivals, the Holy Week Moriones.

name.zh: 菲律宾国家博物馆马林杜克分馆
name.en: National Museum of the Philippines - Marinduque

intro.zh: 民都洛岛是菲律宾第七大岛，陆地面积 10,571 平方公里，2024 年人口 1,430,921 人，位于吕宋岛西南外海、巴拉望东北。岛分为西民都洛省和东民都洛省，卡拉潘是岛上唯一的城市。最高峰哈尔康山海拔 2,586 米。北岸的波多黎各加莱拉以白沙滩和潜水闻名，内陆还有瀑布和国家公园。
intro.en: Mindoro is the seventh-largest island in the Philippines, with 10,571 square kilometres of land and 1,430,921 people in 2024, lying off the southwestern coast of Luzon and northeast of Palawan. It is split into Occidental and Oriental Mindoro, and Calapan is its only city. Mount Halcon, at 2,586 metres, is its highest point. Puerto Galera on the north coast is known for white beaches and diving.

name.zh: 波多黎各加莱拉白沙滩
伊格利特—巴科山国家公园

intro.zh: 班塔延岛位于米沙鄢海，在宿务岛北端以西、隔塔尼翁海峡相望，面积 108.77 平方公里，2015 年人口 145,436 人。岛上分为班塔延、马德里德霍斯和圣菲三个镇，其中东南部的圣菲是旅游中心。全岛地势低平，大部分海拔不到 10 米，遍布椰林，白沙滩和潟湖是主要看点。
intro.en: Bantayan Island lies in the Visayan Sea, west of the northern end of Cebu across the Tañon Strait. It covers 108.77 square kilometres and had 145,436 people in 2015, divided among Bantayan, Madridejos and Santa Fe, the last being the centre of tourism. The island is flat, mostly below 10 metres and covered with coconut trees, and its white beaches and lagoons are the main draw.

intro.zh: 卡米金是保和海上的岛省，距棉兰老北岸约 10 公里，面积和人口都是全国第二小的省，首府曼巴豪。这里以甜兰撒果和每年十月第三个周末的兰撒节闻名。岛上的希博克-希博克火山保护景观区是东盟遗产公园，还有沉没墓地、老教堂遗址等国家文化瑰宝，以及温泉和瀑布。
intro.en: Camiguin is an island province in the Bohol Sea, about 10 kilometres off northern Mindanao, and the second-smallest province in both population and area; Mambajao is its capital. It is famous for sweet lanzones, celebrated at a festival on the third weekend of October. The Mount Hibok-Hibok Protected Landscape is an ASEAN Heritage Park, and the Sunken Cemetery and old church ruins are National Cultural Treasures, alongside hot springs and waterfalls.

intro.zh: 锡基霍尔是内格罗斯岛大区的岛省，按人口和面积是全国第三小的省，首府锡基霍尔镇。它位于宿务以南、东内格罗斯东南、薄荷西南、棉兰老以北。西班牙殖民时期因萤火虫在树间闪烁，被称为“火之岛”。岛上以神秘的民俗疗愈传说、瀑布和白沙滩著称。
intro.en: Siquijor is an island province of the Negros Island Region and the third smallest in the country by population and area; its capital is the town of Siquijor. It lies south of Cebu, southeast of Negros Oriental, southwest of Bohol and north of Mindanao. The Spaniards called it Isla del Fuego, the Island of Fire, after the fireflies glowing in its trees. It is known for folk-healing lore, waterfalls and white beaches.

photo.author: RM Bulseco from Davao City, Philippines

intro.zh: 马拉帕斯夸岛位于米沙鄢海，与宿务岛最北端隔着 6.8 公里宽的浅海峡相望，行政上属达安班塔延镇的洛贡村。全岛只有约 2.5 公里长、1 公里宽，分布着八个小村落，2024 年人口约 6,129 人。岛周珊瑚礁与潜点众多，是潜水爱好者心中的名地，沙滩边多是悠闲的小度假村。
intro.en: Malapascua sits in the Visayan Sea, 6.8 kilometres across a shallow strait from the northern tip of Cebu, and belongs to barangay Logon in Daanbantayan. The island is only about 2.5 by 1 kilometres, with eight small hamlets and about 6,129 residents in 2024. Reefs and dive sites ring the coast, making it a favourite among divers, and relaxed dive resorts line its beaches.

intro.zh: 帕西汉岛是宿务省卡莫特斯群岛的主岛之一，岛上的圣弗朗西斯科镇 2024 年人口 61,092 人。岛中央的达瑙湖是一片宁静的淡水湖，海岸有白沙滩和海蚀洞，还有可以跳水的天然洞穴水潭，与相邻的波罗岛有堤道相连。
intro.en: Pacijan is one of the main Camotes Islands of Cebu province; the municipality of San Francisco on it had 61,092 people in 2024. At the heart of the island lies Lake Danao, a calm freshwater lake, while its coast offers white beaches, sea caves and cave pools for swimming. A causeway links it to neighbouring Poro Island.

intro.zh: 马斯巴特岛是马斯巴特省三大岛中最大的一个，另两个是蒂考岛和布里亚斯岛。按面积和人口都排全国第 11 位，下辖 14 个镇和 1 个市，2024 年人口 732,518 人，马斯巴特市是最大城镇。这里以牧牛业和牛仔节闻名，海岸有灯塔、沙洲和红树林步道。
intro.en: Masbate Island is the largest of the three major islands of Masbate province, alongside Ticao and Burias. It ranks 11th in the Philippines in both area and population, with 14 municipalities and 1 city and 732,518 people in 2024; Masbate City is its largest settlement. The island is known for cattle ranching, and its coast offers a historic lighthouse, sandbars and mangrove walkways.

intro.zh: 卡坦端内斯岛是比科尔大区的岛省，菲律宾第 12 大岛，隔马克达海峡与南甘马粦省相望，首府和人口最多的城镇是维拉克，2024 年人口 261,169 人。全省以主岛为主，外加帕奈岛、帕伦巴内斯群岛等离岛。岛东岸直面太平洋，浪况出名，海岸岬角和洞穴众多；岛上还有菲律宾第二古老的菊石化石点。
intro.en: Catanduanes is an island province of the Bicol Region and the 12th-largest island in the Philippines, east of Camarines Sur across the Maqueda Channel. Its capital and most populous town is Virac, and the province had 261,169 people in 2024. Besides the main island it includes Panay, the Palumbanes group and many islets. Its Pacific-facing east coast is known for surf, headlands and caves, and it hosts the second-oldest ammonite fossil site in the country.

intro.zh: 吉马拉斯岛是西米沙鄢大区吉马拉斯省的主岛，位于班乃湾、夹在班乃岛和内格罗斯岛之间，西北方就是伊洛伊洛市，整座岛属于“伊洛伊洛—吉马拉斯都会区”。首府是霍丹，最大的市镇是布埃纳维斯塔。它原是伊洛伊洛的分省，1992 年 5 月 22 日独立建省。这里以芒果闻名，海边有灯塔、风电场和许多小岛海湾。
intro.en: Guimaras Island is the main island of Guimaras province in Western Visayas, set in the Panay Gulf between Panay and Negros, with Iloilo City just to the northwest; the whole island belongs to Metro Iloilo–Guimaras. Its capital is Jordan and its largest town is Buenavista. Once a sub-province of Iloilo, it became a province on May 22, 1992. It is famous for its mangoes, and its coast has lighthouses, a wind farm and many small island coves.

photo.commons: File:Guimaras Island & Siete Pecados Islands, Dumangas, Iloilo, Sep 2026.jpg
photo.author: Ralff Nestor Nacor

intro.zh: 塔利库德岛是达沃湾里萨马尔岛南边的一座小岛，与萨马尔岛同属北达沃省萨马尔岛花园市。它离达沃市不远，比萨马尔岛更安静，海岸多是小型度假村和浮潜、潜水点，岛上有一棵上百年的老榕树，适合当天往返或住上一晚。
intro.en: Talikud is a small island in the Davao Gulf just south of Samal Island, and together with Samal it forms the Island Garden City of Samal in Davao del Norte. Close to Davao City yet quieter than its bigger neighbour, its shore is dotted with small resorts and snorkelling and dive spots, and an old century balete tree stands on the island, making it a good day trip or overnight escape.

intro.zh: 蒂纳加岛是北甘马粦省温松斯镇外卡拉瓜斯群岛的两大岛之一，长约八公里。岛上最出名的是一条叫“马哈邦布汉京”的长白沙滩，意为“长长的沙滩”，深受背包客和露营者喜爱；普华永道曾把它列为菲律宾十大潜力旅游地之首。
intro.en: Tinaga is one of the two major islands of the Calaguas Group off Vinzons, Camarines Norte, about eight kilometres long. It is famous for its long white beach, Mahabang Buhangin, literally "long beach", popular with backpackers and campers from Manila and elsewhere. PwC once ranked it first among the up-and-coming tourist destinations in its Philippine gems report.

name.zh: 巴拉格巴格群岛观景点

intro.zh: 蒂考岛陆地面积 334 平方公里，是马斯巴特省三大岛之一，隔蒂考水道与比科尔半岛相望；另两座大岛是马斯巴特岛和布里亚斯岛。岛上分为巴图安、蒙雷亚尔、圣费尔南多和圣哈辛托四个镇。附近海域以蝠鲼和鲸鲨出没闻名，海岸有安静的白沙滩。
intro.en: Ticao Island has a land area of 334 square kilometres and is one of the three major islands of Masbate province, separated from the Bicol Peninsula by the Ticao Pass; the other two are Masbate and Burias. It is divided into the municipalities of Batuan, Monreal, San Fernando and San Jacinto. The surrounding waters are known for manta rays and whale sharks, and its coast has quiet white beaches.

intro.zh: 塔布拉斯岛是朗布隆省最大的岛，名字源自西班牙语，殖民前被称为“奥西甘岛”，初与西方接触时只有 256 人住在小村里。西海岸中部的奥迪翁甘是主要港口，也是全省人口最多的镇；全岛共分九个镇。岛上有古老的石造教堂、灯塔和宁静的海湾。
intro.en: Tablas is the largest island of Romblon province, and its name is of Spanish origin; before colonisation it was known as Osigan, home to just 256 people in small villages at the time of Western contact. Odiongan on the west coast is its main port and the province's most populous town, and the island is divided into nine municipalities. Old stone churches, lighthouses and quiet bays await visitors.

name.zh: 圣文森特·费雷尔堂区教堂

intro.zh: 锡布延岛是一座新月形的岛，位于同名的锡布延海，是朗布隆省第二大岛，面积 445 平方公里，2020 年人口 62,815 人。最高峰贵亭山海拔 2,058 米，山脊如锯齿。由于从未与其他陆地相连，这里物种独特，被科学家称为“亚洲的加拉帕戈斯”，山林、瀑布和河流保存完好。
intro.en: Sibuyan is a crescent-shaped island in the Sibuyan Sea and the second-largest of Romblon province, covering 445 square kilometres with 62,815 people in 2020. Its highest peak, the saw-toothed Mount Guiting-Guiting, rises to 2,058 metres. Never connected to any other land, the island has evolved a unique flora and fauna, earning it the nickname "the Galápagos of Asia", with forests, waterfalls and rivers still intact.

intro.zh: 奥兰戈岛是奥兰戈岛群的主岛，岛群位于麦克坦岛以东 5 公里，总面积约 1,030 公顷，分属拉普拉普市和科尔多瓦镇，是宿务的重要旅游地。这里以野生动物保护区闻名，候鸟成群，1994 年成为菲律宾第一个被认定的拉姆萨尔国际重要湿地。
intro.en: Olango is the main island of the Olango Island Group, 5 kilometres east of Mactan, which covers about 1,030 hectares split between Lapu-Lapu City and Cordova and is a major tourist destination in Cebu. It is known for its wildlife sanctuary, visited by flocks of migratory birds, and in 1994 became the first Ramsar Wetland Site declared in the Philippines.

name.zh: 奥兰戈岛野生动物保护区

intro.zh: 波罗岛位于宿务岛以东、莱特岛以西，是卡莫特斯群岛的四座岛之一，另三座是帕西汉、蓬松和图朗。岛上有波罗和图德拉两个镇，也是东西方在太平洋最早接触的地点之一。岛上溶洞众多，灯塔、海蚀岩和山丘构成主要风景。
intro.en: Poro Island lies east of Cebu and west of Leyte and is one of the four Camotes Islands, together with Pacijan, Ponson and Tulang. It holds two municipalities, Poro and Tudela, and is counted among the early Pacific contact sites between East and West. Limestone caves, a lighthouse, sea-carved rocks and hills are its main sights.

intro.zh: 阿波岛是一座面积约 74 公顷的火山岛，位于内格罗斯岛东南端外 7 公里、东内格罗斯省会杜马格特以南 30 公里。“Apo” 在米沙鄢语里意为“长者”。岛周海域是依《国家综合保护区法》设立的海洋保护区，珊瑚礁保存完好，已成为热门的潜水和浮潜目的地；岛上有两家带潜水中心的度假村和一座灯塔。
intro.en: Apo Island is a volcanic island of about 74 hectares, 7 kilometres off the southeastern tip of Negros and 30 kilometres south of Dumaguete. Its name means "elder" in the Visayan languages. The surrounding waters form a marine reserve protected under the National Integrated Protected Areas Act, and the healthy reefs have made it a popular diving and snorkelling destination, served by two small dive resorts.

name.zh: 阿波岛保护景观与海景区

intro.zh: 帕纳翁岛是南莱特省的一座小岛，位于莱特岛以南，东隔苏里高海峡与迪纳加特和棉兰老相望，南北长约 30 公里。最大镇利洛安通过瓦瓦大桥与莱特本岛相连。潜水和观鲸鲨是这里的热门活动，2025 年周边海域被划为帕纳翁岛保护海景区。
intro.en: Panaon is a small island of Southern Leyte, south of Leyte and separated from Dinagat and Mindanao by the Surigao Strait; it is about 30 kilometres long. Its largest town, Liloan, is linked to Leyte by the Wawa Bridge. Scuba diving and whale shark watching are popular, and in 2025 the surrounding waters were declared the Panaon Island Protected Seascape.

intro.zh: 卡利科安岛位于莱特湾以东、萨马岛东南角外，属东萨马省吉万镇。从塔克洛班坐约三小时巴士即可抵达。岛东面向太平洋，浪况优良，被称为“米沙鄢冲浪之都”，岛上还有洞穴、观景点和海洋保护区。
intro.en: Calicoan is an island east of Leyte Gulf, off the southeastern point of Samar, and part of the municipality of Guiuan in Eastern Samar. It can be reached from Tacloban by a three-hour bus ride. Facing the Pacific, its reliable waves have earned it the title Surfing Capital of the Visayas, and it also offers caves, viewpoints and a marine sanctuary.

name.zh: 吉万保护景观与海景区

photo.commons: File:View of Calicoan Island and the Philippine Sea from the DOST-PAGASA Guiuan Weather Station in 2022.jpg
photo.author: Nairb.Idi9

intro.zh: 利马萨瓦岛是南莱特省的一个岛镇，2024 年人口 6,480 人，是全省人口最少的镇。它在菲律宾史上地位特殊，被认定为 1521 年菲律宾第一次天主教弥撒的举行地，岛上建有纪念圣殿和展览馆，每年吸引朝圣者和历史爱好者前来。
intro.en: Limasawa is an island municipality of Southern Leyte, with 6,480 people in 2024, the least populated town in the province. It holds a special place in Philippine history as the recognised site of the first Catholic Mass in the country in 1521, commemorated by a hilltop shrine and a gallery that draw pilgrims and history lovers every year.

name.zh: 利马萨瓦第一次弥撒圣殿

intro.zh: 朗布隆岛是朗布隆省三大岛之一，岛上的朗布隆镇是省会，2024 年人口 39,004 人，辖区还包括阿拉德、科布拉多尔和洛格邦等小岛。朗布隆以大理石产业闻名，产量居全国第二；老城有西班牙时代的双子要塞和大教堂，周边海滩未经开发，是历史与海岛兼具的目的地。
intro.en: Romblon Island is one of the three major islands of Romblon province, and its town of Romblon is the provincial capital, with 39,004 people in 2024; the municipality also covers the islands of Alad, Cobrador and Logbon. Romblon is known for its marble industry, the second largest in the country, and for its Spanish-era twin forts and cathedral, alongside unspoilt beaches.

intro.zh: 库约岛是库约群岛的中心和最大岛，群岛约有 45 座岛，位于巴拉望本岛东北、民都洛以南、班乃以西。库约岛是火山岛，面积约 57 平方公里、长约 14 公里。岛上的库约镇历史悠久，有西班牙时代的库约堡，附近海域散布着许多珊瑚岛。
intro.en: Cuyo Island is the largest island and centre of the Cuyo Archipelago, a group of about 45 islands northeast of Palawan, south of Mindoro and west of Panay. The volcanic island covers about 57 square kilometres and is about 14 kilometres long. Its old town of Cuyo is home to the Spanish-era Fort Cuyo, and many coral islands dot the surrounding sea.

intro.zh: 马纽阿亚岛是马林杜克省东北外海的一座小岛，与蒙蓬岛等小岛相邻，属马林杜克离岛群。岛上环绕着多处细白沙滩，从岛边可以远眺蒙蓬岛，附近还有退潮时露出的帕拉德沙洲。岛上几乎没有旅游设施，保持着渔村小岛的原貌。
intro.en: Maniuaya is a small island off the northeastern coast of Marinduque, next to Mompog and other islets of the province. It is ringed by several fine white beaches, from which visitors can look across to Mompog Island, and the Palad sandbar appears nearby at low tide. With hardly any tourist facilities, it keeps the feel of a simple fishing island.

intro.zh: 锡科贡岛是伊洛伊洛省北部的度假岛，距班乃岛东北岸 9.95 公里，属卡尔斯镇，由三个村组成，2020 年人口 4,275 人，面积 11.6 平方公里。岛由阿亚拉置地等公司联合开发，经营三家高端酒店，可以跳岛去巨人群岛，也能皮划艇、桨板、浮潜和徒步。
intro.en: Sicogon is a resort island in northern Iloilo, 9.95 kilometres off the northeast coast of Panay, under the municipality of Carles. It has three barangays, 4,275 people as of 2020 and a land area of 11.6 square kilometres. Managed by a joint venture of Ayala Land, it runs three upscale hotels and offers island hopping to the Islas de Gigantes, kayaking, paddleboarding, snorkelling and hiking.

intro.zh: 巴坦岛是巴丹群岛省的主岛，也是菲律宾最北端群岛中第二大的岛，省会巴斯科就在岛上。岛上草坡起伏、海风强劲，传统的石屋、灯塔和伊拉亚火山构成独特风景，是远离人潮的北境秘境，常被称为菲律宾最美的高原草原海岸。
intro.en: Batan Island is the main island of Batanes, the archipelagic province at the northern tip of the Philippines, and the second-largest island of that group; the provincial capital Basco is here. Rolling grassy hills swept by strong winds, traditional stone houses, lighthouses and Mount Iraya give it a distinctive landscape far from the crowds, and its coastal hills are often called some of the most beautiful in the country.

intro.zh: 金塔坎岛又名基纳塔尔坎岛，位于宿务岛西岸外约 25 公里、班塔延岛东北 12 公里，属圣菲镇，有三个村。岛呈长椭圆形，南北长约 6.8 公里、东西宽约 2.5 公里，地势多丘陵，东岸有一大片潟湖，海岸以高耸的岩壁为主，间有平缓沙滩，周边珊瑚礁和海草床丰富。
intro.en: Kinatarkan, also called Guintacan, lies about 25 kilometres off the west coast of Cebu and 12 kilometres northeast of Bantayan, within Santa Fe, and has three barangays. The elongated island is about 6.8 kilometres long and 2.5 kilometres wide, hilly, with a large lagoon on its east coast. Towering rock cliffs dominate the shore, broken by a few flat beaches, and reefs and seagrass beds lie offshore.

intro.zh: 马拉利森岛又名马拉里森岛，是安蒂克省库拉西镇外的一座小岛，也是一个村。岛上有几座小山丘，从山顶俯瞰，白沙滩和蓝色海湾一览无余，还有小洞穴和礁石小岛可以探访；岛民生活淳朴，是班乃岛西岸近年很受欢迎的一日游海岛。
intro.en: Mararison, also known as Malalison, is a small island and barangay of Culasi in Antique province, off the west coast of Panay. A few grassy hills rise above its white beaches, and from their tops visitors look down on sandbars and blue coves; there is also a small sea cave and a rocky islet nearby. With its quiet village life it has become a popular day trip on the west coast of Panay.

intro.zh: 班顿岛位于锡布延海北部、马林杜克南端附近，全岛构成朗布隆省班顿镇，2024 年人口 5,848 人，居民说班顿语（又称阿西语）。1936 年国家博物馆在岛上的古扬岸洞穴发现了棺木和古老裹尸布等文物，证明殖民前已有人居住。现今聚落建于 1622 年，是全省最古老的聚落，还有西班牙时代的圣何塞要塞。
intro.en: Banton Island lies in the northern Sibuyan Sea near the southern tip of Marinduque; the whole island forms the municipality of Banton in Romblon, with 5,848 people in 2024 who speak Bantoanon, or Asi. Coffins, an ancient burial cloth and other finds from the Guyangan Cave System, excavated by the National Museum in 1936, show pre-colonial settlement. The present town, founded in 1622, is the oldest settlement in the province and keeps the Spanish-era Fuerza de San José.

name.zh: 阿西文化艺术研究中心
name.en: Asi Studies Center for Culture and the Arts (ASCCA)

intro.zh: 布里亚斯岛是马斯巴特省三大岛之一，隔布里亚斯水道与比科尔半岛相望，另两座大岛是蒂考岛和马斯巴特岛。岛上只有克拉维里亚和圣帕斯夸尔两个镇，海湾众多、山丘起伏，外海的阿尼马索拉岛以奇岩闻名，是近年逐渐被发现的小众目的地。
intro.en: Burias Island is one of the three major islands of Masbate province, separated from the Bicol Peninsula by the Burias Pass; the other two are Ticao and Masbate. It has just two municipalities, Claveria and San Pascual. Many bays and rolling hills shape the island, and offshore Animasola Island is known for its rock formations, making Burias a quietly emerging destination.

name.zh: 圣帕斯夸尔·贝隆堂区教堂

photo.commons: File:Sunset in Burias Island, San Pascual, Masbate.jpg
photo.author: Irvin Parco Sto. Tomas

intro.zh: 杜马兰岛是巴拉望省的一座岛，最近处距巴拉望本岛只有约 2.70 公里，乘螃蟹船即可抵达。岛分属杜马兰和阿拉塞利两个镇，两镇的镇中心都在岛上；西侧是杜马兰水道，东北方是达朗阿嫩群岛。岛上有西班牙时代的杜马兰堡和多处白沙滩。
intro.en: Dumaran Island in Palawan province lies about 2.70 kilometres from mainland Palawan at its closest point and can be reached by pump boat. It is divided between the municipalities of Dumaran and Araceli, both of whose town centres are on the island; the Dumaran Channel runs to the west and the Dalanganem islands lie to the northeast. A Spanish-era fort and several white beaches are its main sights.

intro.zh: 巴拉巴克岛是巴拉望省最南端的岛，隔巴拉巴克海峡与马来西亚沙巴相距约 50 公里，是菲律宾最西端的无争议岛屿。岛构成巴拉巴克镇的主体，分为 14 个村。岛南端有历史悠久的梅尔维尔角灯塔，周边海域白沙洲与海星滩散布，风景原始。
intro.en: Balabac Island is the southernmost island of Palawan province and therefore the westernmost undisputed island of the Philippines, some 50 kilometres north of Sabah across the Balabac Strait. It forms the main part of the municipality of Balabac and is divided into 14 barangays. Its southern tip is crowned by the historic Cape Melville Lighthouse, and the surrounding waters are sprinkled with white sandbars and starfish flats.

intro.zh: 锡利翁岛又称“处女岛”，当地也叫 Hilantagaan Diot 或 Pulo Diyot，是中米沙鄢宿务省圣菲镇外的一座小岛，靠近班塔延岛。岛边海水清浅、沙滩洁白，是从班塔延岛出发跳岛游的常见一站。
intro.en: Silion, also known as Virgin Island, Hilantagaan Diot or Pulo Diyot, is a small island in the municipality of Santa Fe in Central Visayas, close to Bantayan Island. Its clear shallow water and white sand make it a regular stop on island-hopping trips from Bantayan.

photo.commons: File:Virgin Island (Sillon Island), Santa Fe, Bantayan, Cebu.jpg
photo.author: MikelleBandin

intro.zh: 希卢通甘岛是奥兰戈岛群的一员，位于麦克坦岛与达纳洪礁之间，距科尔多瓦镇约 5 公里，归科尔多瓦管辖，人口 1,851 人。岛上有白沙滩和海洋保护区，可以浮潜和潜水，是宿务跳岛游的热门一站；附近的纳卢苏安岛也属同一个村。
intro.en: Gilutongan belongs to the Olango Island Group between Mactan and the Danajon Bank, about 5 kilometres from Cordova, which administers it; it has 1,851 residents. White beaches and a marine sanctuary for snorkelling and diving make it a popular stop on Cebu island-hopping tours, and nearby Nalusuan Island belongs to the same barangay.

intro.zh: 纳布罗特岛位于吉马拉斯省霍丹镇辛纳普萨潘村，面积约 39,500 平方米，从新巴伦西亚镇的阿卢比霍德海滩就能望见。小岛被开发成简朴的海岛度假地，周边还有三岛海滩、灯塔和小海湾，是吉马拉斯跳岛游常见的一站。
intro.en: Naburot Island lies in barangay Sinapsapan, Jordan, Guimaras, and covers around 39,500 square metres; it can be seen from Alubihod Beach in Nueva Valencia. The islet has been turned into a rustic island retreat, and nearby beaches, a lighthouse and small coves make it a regular stop on Guimaras island-hopping trips.

intro.zh: 霍蒙洪岛位于东萨马省、莱特湾东侧，长约 20 公里，属吉万镇，下辖八个村。它是东西方在太平洋最早接触的地点之一：1521 年麦哲伦船队曾在这座当时无人居住的岛上停泊。岛上立有登陆纪念碑，西北角外还有小岛曼托科南。
intro.en: Homonhon is an island of Eastern Samar on the east side of Leyte Gulf, about 20 kilometres long, belonging to the municipality of Guiuan and made up of eight barangays. It is one of the earliest contact sites between East and West in the Pacific: Magellan's expedition anchored at the then uninhabited island in 1521. A landing marker stands on the island, and the islet of Mantoconan lies off its northwest corner.

photo.commons: File:Homonhon Island, Guiuan, Eastern Samar at sunset.jpg
photo.author: Nairb.Idi9

intro.zh: 潘德阿苏卡岛又名坦皮绍岛或坦巴利萨岛，是米沙鄢海上的一座有人岛，以陡峭的火山锥潘德阿苏卡山（糖面包山）闻名，是吉马拉斯海峡北口的显著地标。岛属伊洛伊洛省康塞普西翁镇，是该镇 16 座离岛中最大的，约占全镇陆地面积 19%，2015 年人口 7,502 人。
intro.en: Pan de Azucar, also known as Tampisaw or Tambaliza Island, is a populated island in the Visayan Sea, known for Mount Pan de Azucar, the steep volcanic Sugarloaf Mountain that serves as a landmark at the northern entrance of the Guimaras Strait. It belongs to Concepcion, Iloilo, and is the largest of the town's 16 outlying islands, making up nearly 19 percent of its land area, with 7,502 people in 2015.

intro.zh: 布卢巴迪扬岛是伊洛伊洛省东北部的一座私人小岛，属康塞普西翁镇波洛皮尼亚村。岛上的沙洲海滩度假村在菲律宾小有名气：退潮时一条白色沙洲把两块陆地连起来，四周是清澈的浅海和附近的伊格邦岛等小岛。
intro.en: Bulubadiangan is a privately owned island in northeastern Iloilo, part of barangay Polopiña in Concepcion. Its Sandbar Island Beach Resort is moderately well known in the Philippines: at low tide a white sandbar joins its two halves, surrounded by clear shallows and neighbouring islets such as Igbon.

intro.zh: 帕米拉坎岛位于薄荷岛以南 12.5 公里的保和海上，是巴克拉永镇 17 个村之一，2015 年人口 1,418 人。岛民过去捕猎鲸、海豚和蝠鲼，如今转为经营观海豚、观鲸之旅和小型渔业。岛名可能意为“蝠鲼栖息地”，也可能来自鱼叉“pamilac”。岛东北有一座约 200 年历史的西班牙瞭望堡。
intro.en: Pamilacan is an island barangay 12.5 kilometres south of Bohol in the Bohol Sea, one of the 17 barangays of Baclayon, with 1,418 people in 2015. Islanders once hunted whales, dolphins and manta rays but now run dolphin- and whale-watching tours alongside small-scale fishing. The name may mean "resting place of the mantas" or come from pamilac, a harpoon. A 200-year-old Spanish watchtower fort stands on its northeast side.

intro.zh: 帕马利坎岛是库约群岛中一座沙质小岛，位于巴拉望与班乃之间的苏禄海，坐落在一片约 7 平方公里的珊瑚礁中央。岛长约 2.5 公里，最宽处只有 500 米。全岛为私人所有，开发成顶级度假村阿曼普洛，只接待住客，是菲律宾最昂贵的私人海岛之一。
intro.en: Pamalican is a small sandy island of the Cuyo group in the Sulu Sea, between Palawan and Panay, set in the middle of a coral reef of about 7 square kilometres. The island is about 2.5 kilometres long and only 500 metres wide at its widest. Entirely privately owned, it is home to the exclusive Amanpulo resort, which only receives its own guests, making it one of the country's most expensive island escapes.

photo.author: The original uploader was PHG at English Wikipedia.

intro.zh: 桑加特岛是巴拉望省卡拉棉群岛北部的一座小岛，距布桑加岛海岸 2 公里、靠近科隆镇宾图安村。岛上大部分已开发为有小屋和独立别墅的度假村，常有潜水者来此探访二战时沉没在卡拉棉群岛一带的日本沉船。
intro.en: Sangat Island is a tiny island in the northern Calamian Islands of Palawan, 2 kilometres off the coast of Busuanga near Barangay Bintuan in Coron. Much of it has been turned into a resort with cottages and private villas, frequented by scuba divers who come to explore the Japanese shipwrecks sunk around the Calamian Islands in World War II.

intro.zh: 萨布唐岛是巴丹群岛省萨布唐镇的主岛，萨布唐是巴丹群岛最南的岛镇，2024 年人口 1,774 人，辖区还有伊武霍斯和德奎两座无人小岛。这里以灯塔和查瓦扬、萨维杜格两个伊瓦坦村落的古老石屋闻名，也有传教士风格的教堂和白沙滩。
intro.en: Sabtang Island is the main island of Sabtang, the southernmost island municipality of Batanes, with 1,774 people in 2024; it also includes the uninhabited islets of Ivuhos and Dequey. It is known for its lighthouse and the old stone houses of the Ivatan villages of Chavayan and Savidug, as well as Mission-style churches and white sand beaches.

photo.commons: File:Chavayan, Sabtang Island in Batanes, Philippines.jpg
photo.author: Johnkevinreglos

intro.zh: 伊特巴亚特岛是巴丹群岛省伊特巴亚特镇的主岛，按面积是巴丹群岛中最大的岛。伊特巴亚特是菲律宾最北的镇，距台湾最南端 156 公里，2024 年人口 2,937 人；镇辖范围还包括迪奥戈、米桑加和最北端的马武利斯等无人小岛。岛四周是高耸的珊瑚石灰岩崖，只有少数港口可以登岸。
intro.en: Itbayat is the main island of the municipality of Itbayat in Batanes and, by land area, the largest island of the province. Itbayat is the country's northernmost municipality, 156 kilometres from the southern tip of Taiwan, with 2,937 people in 2024; it also covers small uninhabited islands such as Di'nem, Misanga and Mavulis, the northernmost of all. Tall coralline limestone cliffs ring the island, with only a few landing ports.

intro.zh: 科雷希多岛扼守马尼拉湾入口，位于马尼拉以西 48 公里，行政上属甲米地市。因地势险要，历史上岛上一直筑有海岸炮台，美国殖民时期与埃尔弗赖莱岛、卡瓦略岛等一起组成马尼拉湾的港防要塞，本岛即米尔斯堡。二战期间这里是激战之地，如今的隧道、炮台遗址和纪念馆吸引大批历史游客。
intro.en: Corregidor guards the entrance of Manila Bay, 48 kilometres west of Manila, and is administered as part of Cavite City. Its strategic position made it a fortress armed with coastal batteries; in the American period it became Fort Mills, the largest of the harbour defences alongside El Fraile and Caballo islands. It saw heavy fighting in World War II, and its tunnels, gun batteries and memorials now draw history-minded visitors.

intro.zh: 巴莱辛岛是吕宋岛东岸外的一座私人热带小岛，本身也是一个村，行政上属奎松省波利略镇。岛上整体开发为会员制度假村，沙滩、椰林和海湾环绕，只接待会员和受邀客人，因此显得神秘而安静，是菲律宾最有名的高端私人海岛之一。
intro.en: Balesin Island is a private tropical island and barangay off the eastern coast of Luzon, administered as part of the municipality of Polillo in Quezon province. The whole island is run as a members-only resort, with beaches, coconut groves and quiet coves, and is open only to members and their guests, which gives it a reputation as one of the most exclusive island getaways in the Philippines.

intro.zh: 丹胡甘岛是西内格罗斯省考阿延镇辖下一座 43 公顷的小岛，由“菲律宾珊瑚礁与雨林保护基金会”负责管护，以生态旅游推广生物多样性保护。岛上保留着原生林、潟湖和珊瑚礁，游客只能参加小规模的自然导览，在观景点看日落、在保护区浮潜。
intro.en: Danjugan Island is a 43-hectare island under the jurisdiction of Cauayan, Negros Occidental. It is cared for by the Philippine Reef and Rainforest Conservation Foundation, which uses ecotourism to promote awareness of biodiversity protection. The island keeps its native forest, lagoons and coral reefs, and visitors come on small guided nature trips to watch sunsets from its viewpoints and snorkel in the protected waters.

intro.zh: 霍洛岛是菲律宾西南部的一座火山岛，苏禄省的主岛，省会霍洛就在岛上。它位于婆罗洲与棉兰老岛之间的苏禄群岛，人口约 500,000 人。岛上分布着霍洛火山群的众多火山锥和火山口，其中包括活火山达霍山；当地以陶苏格人的伊斯兰文化为特色。
intro.en: Jolo is a volcanic island in the southwest Philippines and the main island of Sulu province, whose capital shares its name. Lying in the Sulu Archipelago between Borneo and Mindanao, it has about 500,000 people. The island is dotted with the cones and craters of the Jolo Group of Volcanoes, including the active Bud Dajo, and its culture is shaped by the Muslim Tausug people.

name.zh: 菲律宾国家博物馆苏禄分馆
name.en: National Museum of the Philippines - Sulu

intro.zh: 科隆岛是巴拉望北部卡拉棉群岛中第三大的岛，位于马尼拉西南约 310 公里，以周边的二战日本沉船闻名。岛上石灰岩峭壁环抱着清澈的湖泊与潟湖，整个区域受多项法令保护；它也是原住民塔格巴努亚人的祖传领地，1998 年 6 月 5 日获正式认定，岛上分为两个村。
intro.en: Coron is the third-largest island of the Calamian Islands in northern Palawan, about 310 kilometres southwest of Manila, and is known for the Japanese shipwrecks of World War II around it. Its limestone cliffs enclose clear lakes and lagoons, and the whole area is protected by several proclamations. The island is the ancestral domain of the indigenous Tagbanwa people, recognised on June 5, 1998, and comprises two barangays.

intro.zh: 波利略岛位于菲律宾群岛东北部，是波利略群岛中最大、也是得名的岛，隔波利略海峡与吕宋岛相望，构成拉蒙湾的北侧。全岛分属波利略、布尔德奥斯和帕努库兰三个镇，2010 年人口 64,802 人。岛上栖息着易危的布塔安巨蜥（科莫多龙的近亲），还有瀑布与沙洲。
intro.en: Polillo is an island in the northeast of the Philippine archipelago, the largest and namesake of the Polillo Islands, separated from Luzon by the Polillo Strait and forming the northern side of Lamon Bay. It is split among the municipalities of Polillo, Burdeos and Panukulan and had 64,802 residents in 2010. The island is home to the Butaan, a vulnerable monitor lizard related to the Komodo dragon, as well as waterfalls and sandbars.

name.zh: 马塔拉斯纳巴托观景点

intro.zh: 埃尔弗赖莱岛位于马尼拉湾口、科雷希多岛以南，整座岛被改建成德拉姆堡——一座外形像战舰的钢筋混凝土海上要塞，绰号“混凝土战舰”，由美国在 1909 年修建。二战时被日军占领，后被美军纵火夺回，从此废弃。如今它是马尼拉湾最奇特的历史遗迹之一。
intro.en: El Fraile Island sits at the mouth of Manila Bay, south of Corregidor, and was turned entirely into Fort Drum, a reinforced concrete sea fort shaped like a battleship and nicknamed the "concrete battleship", built by the United States in 1909. Captured by Japanese forces in World War II and retaken when US troops set it ablaze, it has been abandoned ever since and remains one of the strangest relics of the bay.

intro.zh: 卢邦岛是卢邦群岛七座岛中最大的一座，位于民都洛岛北端西北，距八打雁省卡拉塔甘以西约 40 公里、马尼拉西南约 117 公里，属西民都洛省，分为卢邦和卢克两个镇。群岛远离大陆，生态独特而脆弱，岛上以连绵的丘陵和宁静海岸为主。
intro.en: Lubang Island is the largest of the seven islands of the Lubang Group, northwest of the northern tip of Mindoro, about 40 kilometres west of Calatagan, Batangas, and 117 kilometres southwest of Manila. It belongs to Occidental Mindoro and is divided into the municipalities of Lubang and Looc. Isolated from any larger landmass, the group is biologically unique and fragile, with rolling hills and quiet shores.

intro.zh: 阿尼马索拉岛位于马斯巴特省圣帕斯夸尔镇外海，是布里亚斯岛附近的一座火山岩小岛。岛上布满被海浪雕琢的奇形岩石和层层岩壁，搭配清澈海水，近年因“菲律宾的石头岛”式风景在社交媒体走红，常与附近海滩连成一日游线路。
intro.en: Animasola Island lies off San Pascual in Masbate province, near Burias Island. The small volcanic island is covered with rock formations and layered cliffs carved by the waves, set in clear water, and has become popular on social media for its unusual stony scenery. It is usually visited on day trips combined with nearby beaches.

intro.zh: 迪纳加特岛位于棉兰老岛东北方，2006 年 12 月之前属北苏里高省，如今是迪纳加特群岛省的主岛，省内几乎所有镇都在这座岛上。岛上保存着大片森林和石灰岩地貌，有蝙蝠保护区、潮汐池和少有人至的海滩，是棉兰老东北角的小众秘境。
intro.en: Dinagat Island lies northeast of Mindanao. Until December 2006 it belonged to Surigao del Norte; it is now the main island of Dinagat Islands province, and almost all of the province's municipalities are on it. The island keeps large forests and limestone landscapes, with a bat sanctuary, tidal pools and little-visited beaches, making it an off-the-beaten-track corner of northeastern Mindanao.

intro.zh: 小卡布高岛又名安东尼娅岛，当地叫它“Cabugao Gamay”（小卡布高），与北边的大卡布高岛相对。它是伊洛伊洛省东北部卡尔斯镇辖下的无人小岛，属巨人群岛南部的三座小岛之一。岛上的观景点能俯瞰中央白沙滩和南端的绿色小山，因此被称为“自拍岛”。
intro.en: Antonia Island is known locally as Cabugao Gamay, "Little Cabugao", in contrast to the bigger Cabugao to its north. It is a small uninhabited island in northeastern Iloilo, one of fourteen islands administered by Carles and one of three minor southern islets of the Islas de Gigantes. Its viewpoint over the central beaches and the green hill at its southern end has earned it the nickname "selfie island".

intro.zh: 考哈甘岛位于宿务海峡，是麦克坦岛外奥兰戈岛群中的一座小岛，归拉普拉普市管辖，2024 年人口 658 人。岛民多靠捕鱼为生，也有人在岛上的海滩度假村工作、摆摊或经营跳岛游。由于远离本岛，家家户户用太阳能板发电，岛上生活简单宁静。
intro.en: Caohagan is a small island in the Cebu Strait, one of the Olango Island Group off Mactan, under the jurisdiction of Lapu-Lapu City, with 658 residents in 2024. Many islanders still fish, while others work at the island's beach resort, sell crafts and snacks, or run island-hopping tours. Being far from the mainland, households rely on solar panels for electricity, and life on the island is simple and quiet.

name.zh: 奥兰戈岛野生动物保护区

intro.zh: 卡格巴莱特岛位于吕宋岛东岸外的拉蒙湾，属奎松省毛班镇。岛上以绵长平缓的白沙滩、退潮时露出的大片沙坪和天然岩池闻名，没有大型开发，多是露营地和小型度假屋，适合想远离城市喧嚣的周末游客。
intro.en: Cagbalete is an island off the east coast of Luzon in Lamon Bay, part of Quezon province and administered by the municipality of Mauban. It is known for long, gently sloping white beaches, vast sand flats exposed at low tide and natural rock pools. With no large developments, only campsites and small cottages, it suits weekend visitors looking to escape the city.

intro.zh: 卡拉延岛位于巴布延岛西南偏西约 39 公里，属吕宋海峡中的巴布延群岛，夹在阿帕里与巴丹群岛之间，比 40 公里外的富加岛更大。岛上独有一种不会飞的鸟——卡拉延秧鸡，2004 年才被确认为新物种。岛上有草坡、灯塔和清澈海湾。
intro.en: Calayan Island lies about 39 kilometres west-southwest of Babuyan Island and belongs to the Babuyan Islands in the Luzon Strait, between Aparri and Batanes; it is larger than Fuga Island, 40 kilometres away. The island is home to the Calayan rail, a flightless bird identified as a separate species in 2004 and found nowhere else. Grassy hills, a lighthouse and clear bays complete the scene.

intro.zh: 巴布延岛又称巴布延克拉罗，是吕宋海峡中巴布延群岛里最高、最北的岛，隔巴士海峡与台湾遥遥相对。全岛构成卡加延省卡拉延镇的巴布延克拉罗村，2020 年人口 1,910 人。它是一座火山岛，岛上有巴布延克拉罗火山和史密斯火山。
intro.en: Babuyan Island, also called Babuyan Claro, is the highest and northernmost island of the Babuyan Islands in the Luzon Strait, facing Taiwan across the Bashi Channel. The whole island forms the barangay of Babuyan Claro in the municipality of Calayan, Cagayan, with 1,910 people in 2020. It is a volcanic island crowned by Babuyan Claro and Smith volcanoes.

intro.zh: 马武利斯岛又叫雅米岛，是巴丹群岛最北端、也是菲律宾国土最北端的岛。岛上无人定居，但有菲律宾武装部队驻守，建有渔民避难所、海水淡化设施、直升机坪、灯塔和号称全国最北的旗杆。最近的岛是南西南方 4 公里的米桑加岛，最近的有人岛伊特巴亚特在南方 38 公里。
intro.en: Mavulis Island, also called Y'ami, is the northernmost of the Batanes Islands and the northernmost island of the Philippines. It is uninhabited but garrisoned by the Armed Forces, which built a shelter for fishermen, a desalination plant, a helipad, a lighthouse and the country's northernmost flagpole. Misanga (North Island) lies 4 kilometres south-southwest, and the nearest inhabited island, Itbayat, is 38 kilometres south.

intro.zh: 大布卡斯岛属北苏里高省，与索科罗镇范围重合，面积 128 平方公里，2020 年人口 25,942 人，分 14 个村。名字在菲律宾西班牙语里意为“大开口”。岛上最出名的是索霍顿湾——穿过低矮洞口进入被石灰岩环抱的潟湖，还有无毒水母潟湖和海蚀洞。
intro.en: Bucas Grande is an island of Surigao del Norte that coincides with the municipality of Socorro, covering 128 square kilometres with 25,942 people in 2020 across 14 barangays. Its name means "large mouth" in Philippine Spanish. The island is best known for Sohoton Cove, a limestone-ringed lagoon entered through a low cave mouth, along with a lagoon of stingless jellyfish and sea caves.

intro.zh: 帕劳伊岛位于吕宋岛东北角外，属卡加延省圣安娜镇，全岛是“帕劳伊岛保护景观与海景区”国家公园。岛北端的恩加尼奥角立着西班牙时代的灯塔，草坡连绵、海蚀崖壮观，周边海域是珊瑚礁保护区，适合徒步和露营。
intro.en: Palaui Island lies off the northeastern tip of Luzon in Santa Ana, Cagayan, and the whole island is a national park, the Palaui Island Protected Landscape and Seascape. At its northern end, Cape Engaño is crowned by a Spanish-era lighthouse above rolling grassland and dramatic sea cliffs, and the surrounding reefs are protected, making it ideal for hiking and camping.

intro.zh: 迪迪卡斯岛是卡加延省的一座活火山岛，位于吕宋海峡、巴布延群岛中卡米金岛东北 22 公里。它原本是海底火山，1857 年首次露出海面，后来又沉没，1952 年再次冒出海面形成现在的小岛。岛上无人居住，只能乘船远观火山锥。
intro.en: Didicas is an active volcanic island of Cagayan province in the Luzon Strait, 22 kilometres northeast of Camiguin Island in the Babuyan group. A submarine volcano, it first broke the ocean surface in 1857 and re-emerged from the sea in 1952 to form today's island. It is uninhabited and can only be admired from a boat.

intro.zh: 萨卢阿格岛位于棉兰老穆斯林自治区的塔威塔威省，长 1.6 公里，属西布图镇，是菲律宾国土最南端的岛。岛上有灯塔，周边散布着西科兰岛等小岛和清真寺，居民以萨玛—巴瑶人为主，海上生活气息浓厚。
intro.en: Saluag Island lies in Tawi-Tawi province in Muslim Mindanao. It is 1.6 kilometres long, belongs to the municipality of Sibutu and is the southernmost island of the Philippines. A lighthouse stands on it, small islands such as Sicolan lie nearby, and its Sama-Bajau communities give it a strong seafaring character.

intro.zh: 阿拉巴特岛位于吕宋岛东南岸外的拉蒙湾，属奎松省，面积 192 平方公里，人口 41,822 人，分为佩雷斯、阿拉巴特和奎松三个镇。岛上有一道山脊，最高峰卡马贡山。最早的居民是尼格利陀人阿拉巴特阿格塔族，其语言濒临消失。西南岸有大片红树林和潮滩。
intro.en: Alabat Island lies in Lamon Bay off the east coast of southern Luzon, in Quezon province. It covers 192 square kilometres, has 41,822 people and is divided into Perez, Alabat and Quezon. A mountain ridge runs along it, topped by Mt. Camagong. Its first inhabitants were the Inagta Alabat, a Negrito people whose language is among the most endangered in the world, and its southwest shore is fringed by mangroves and mudflats.

intro.zh: 佛得岛是一座火山岛，位于吕宋与民都洛之间的佛得岛水道。1988 年，一个欧洲援助项目用太阳能板等技术让岛上小村第一次通上电。此后菲律宾旅游局把这里列为国家海洋保护区之一，周边海域珊瑚与鱼类极其丰富，是潜水者心中的宝地。
intro.en: Verde Island is a volcanic island in the Verde Island Passage between Luzon and Mindoro. In 1988 a European project brought electricity to one of its small villages using solar panels and other technologies. The Philippine Tourism Authority has since declared it one of the country's marine reserves, and the surrounding waters, astonishingly rich in corals and fish, are a treasure for divers.

name.en: Mother of All Asia–Tower of Peace

intro.zh: 富加岛位于吕宋岛以北，属菲律宾第二靠北的巴布延群岛，本身也是一个村，归卡加延省阿帕里镇管辖（阿帕里共有 42 个村）。岛上多白沙滩和丘陵，人口稀少、交通不便，保留着原始的海岛风光。
intro.en: Fuga Island is an island and barangay north of Luzon, part of the Babuyan Islands, the second-northernmost island group of the Philippines. It is one of the 42 barangays of Aparri in Cagayan province. White beaches and low hills cover the sparsely populated island, which is hard to reach and keeps an unspoilt feel.

intro.zh: 塔威塔威岛位于苏禄海与西里伯斯海之间的苏禄群岛，距婆罗洲以东约 64 公里，是塔威塔威省的主岛，面积 580.5 平方公里，为全国第 21 大岛。岛由火山形成，长约 55 公里，丘陵起伏、森林茂密，海岸既有白沙滩也有岩岸，最高海拔 549 米。居民多为萨玛人，信奉伊斯兰教。
intro.en: Tawi-Tawi Island lies in the Sulu Archipelago between the Sulu and Celebes seas, about 64 kilometres east of Borneo, and is the main island of Tawi-Tawi province. At 580.5 square kilometres it is the 21st-largest island of the Philippines. Volcanic in origin and about 55 kilometres long, it is hilly and heavily wooded, with white beaches and rocky coasts and a maximum elevation of 549 metres. Most inhabitants are Muslim Sama people.

intro.zh: 卡兰加曼岛是莱特与宿务之间海上的一座沙洲岛，位于莱特省帕隆彭镇以西 10 公里。名字来自当地语“langgam”，意为鸟；沙洲露出时整座岛形似一只伸长脖子的鸟，相传这里曾是候鸟栖息地。它既是重要的生态繁殖地，也是热门景点，由帕隆彭地方政府所有。
intro.en: Kalanggaman Island is a sandbar island in the sea between Leyte and Cebu, 10 kilometres west of Palompon, Leyte. Its name comes from the local word "langgam", meaning bird: when the sandbar forms, the island looks like a bird stretching its neck, and it is believed to have once been a habitat for migratory birds. It is an important breeding ground as well as a popular attraction, owned by the local government of Palompon.

intro.zh: 巴卢特岛又名马卢隆岛，是西达沃省最南端外的一座潜在活火山岛，位于棉兰老南部。岛中央是巴卢特山（巴卢特火山），一座有喷气孔、但没有历史喷发记录的火山。岛与萨兰加尼岛相邻，海岸岬角和灯塔构成独特风景。
intro.en: Balut Island, also known as Malulong, is a potentially active volcanic island south of the tip of Davao Occidental in southern Mindanao. At its centre rises Mount Balut, a fumarolic volcano with no historical eruptions. It lies next to Sarangani Island, and its capes and lighthouse give the coast a distinctive look.

intro.zh: 卡纳萨岛位于马拉帕斯夸岛以北，本身是一个村，是达安班塔延镇最北端的离岛。岛形像一只海龟，面积 173.5 公顷，四面环抱米沙鄢海。岛上有白沙滩、灯塔和海蚀洞，游客稀少，常被当作马拉帕斯夸之外更安静的选择。
intro.en: Carnaza is a barangay on the island of the same name north of Malapascua, the northernmost offshore island of Daanbantayan. The turtle-shaped island covers 173.5 hectares and is surrounded on all sides by the Visayan Sea. White beaches, a lighthouse and sea caves draw only a few visitors, making it a quieter alternative to Malapascua.

intro.zh: 卡格拉赖岛属阿尔拜省，除两个村归马利利波特镇外，其余都属巴卡凯镇，夹在圣米格尔岛与巴坦岛之间。岛上有豪华度假村米西比斯湾，也是生态旅游地，马塔阿斯洞是阿尔拜仅有的两个对外开放的洞穴之一，另有猴子保护区和观景台。
intro.en: Cagraray is an island of Albay province; apart from two barangays that belong to Malilipot, it is part of Bacacay, and it lies between San Miguel and Batan islands. It is home to the luxury resort of Misibis Bay and is a known eco-tourism spot: Mataas Cave is one of only two caves in Albay open to the public, and there is also a monkey sanctuary and a hilltop view deck.

name.zh: 马纳埃特山猴子保护区

intro.zh: 巴西兰岛是苏禄群岛中最大、最北的主要岛屿，位于三宝颜半岛南岸外，属巴西兰省，大部分在邦萨摩洛自治区。岛上主要有原住民雅坎人、陶苏格人和查瓦卡诺人三大族群，伊莎贝拉是人口最多的城市，省会已迁到拉米坦。岛上多森林与海湾，有自然生物保护区。
intro.en: Basilan Island is the largest and northernmost of the major islands of the Sulu Archipelago, just off the southern coast of the Zamboanga Peninsula, and forms most of Basilan province in the Bangsamoro region. Its three main peoples are the indigenous Yakans, the Tausugs and the Chavacanos; Isabela is its most populous city, while the provincial capital has moved to Lamitan. Forests, bays and a natural biotic reserve cover much of the island.

photo.commons: File:Basilan Island viewed from Zamboanga City.jpg
photo.author: Aldous Mariano Cariño

intro.zh: 塞米拉拉岛位于民都洛岛以南的卡卢亚群岛，归安蒂克省卡卢亚镇管辖，是菲律宾主要的煤矿产地之一。除了采矿，岛民也以捕鱼、拾贝和耕作为生。岛周散布着西布通、伊卢高等小岛，海水清澈，但旅游开发很少。
intro.en: Semirara is an island in the Caluya archipelago south of Mindoro, under the town of Caluya in Antique province, and is one of the major coal-mining sites of the Philippines. Besides mining, islanders live from fishing, seashell gathering and farming. Small islands such as Sibutong and Ilugao dot the clear waters around it, though tourism remains limited.

photo.commons: File:Panian mine in Semirara Island year 2022.jpg
photo.author: Agcotaco

intro.zh: 图巴包岛位于萨马岛东南角外，是东萨马省吉万镇的组成岛屿之一，离镇中心很近。二战期间这里属于美国海军的莱特—萨马海军基地；战后岛上还曾安置过一批来自上海的白俄难民。如今周围小岛环绕，海湾宁静。
intro.en: Tubabao is an island off the southeastern point of Samar and one of the islands of Guiuan in Eastern Samar, close to the town centre. During World War II it was part of the Leyte-Samar Naval Base used by the US Navy. Today it is surrounded by small islets and quiet bays.

photo.author: Angelo Juan Ramos from Makati City, Philippines

intro.zh: 卡比劳岛位于宿务海峡，属薄荷省隆镇，有五个村，人口 4,636 人，居民以捕鱼、农业和旅游为生。岛上有全省唯一的天然湖泊卡比劳岛湖；1978 年全岛被划为旅游区和海洋保护区，周边的珊瑚墙潜点在潜水圈很有名，岛民还用露兜树叶编织草席和草帽。
intro.en: Cabilao is an island in the Cebu Strait, part of Loon in Bohol, with five barangays and 4,636 people living from fishing, farming and tourism. It holds the only natural lake in the province, Cabilao Island Lake. In 1978 the whole island was declared a tourist zone and marine reserve, and its coral walls are well known among divers; islanders also weave mats and hats from pandanus leaves.

intro.zh: 大圣克鲁斯岛是三宝颜市南面巴西兰海峡中的一座有人小岛，距市中心 4 公里，以粉红色珊瑚沙滩闻名：沙子里混着被海浪磨碎的红色管珊瑚。它是世界上少数几处粉红沙滩之一，2017 年被《国家地理》评为全球 21 个最佳海滩之一。
intro.en: Great Santa Cruz Island is a small inhabited island in the Basilan Strait, 4 kilometres south of downtown Zamboanga City, famous for its pink coralline sand, coloured by red organ-pipe coral ground down by the surf and mixed with white sand. It is one of a handful of pink sand beaches in the world, and in 2017 National Geographic named it one of the 21 Best Beaches in the World.

name.zh: 大圣克鲁斯岛粉红沙滩
name.en: Great Sta. Cruz Island Pink Sand Beach

intro.zh: 苏卢安岛是东萨马省吉万镇的一个海岛村，位于莱特湾以东、埃姆登海渊以西。1521 年 3 月 16 日麦哲伦船队停泊在附近当时无人居住的霍蒙洪岛，苏卢安岛民成为最早与船队交易、接触的菲律宾人。岛上立有五百周年历史纪念碑，还有灯塔和小教堂。
intro.en: Suluan is an island barangay of Guiuan in Eastern Samar, east of Leyte Gulf and west of the Emden Deep. When Magellan's expedition anchored at nearby, then uninhabited Homonhon on March 16, 1521, Suluan's inhabitants became the first Filipinos to trade and interact with it. A quincentennial historical marker, a lighthouse and a small chapel stand on the island.

name.zh: 苏卢安五百周年历史纪念碑

intro.zh: 达卢皮里岛位于吕宋岛以北吕宋海峡中的巴布延群岛，全岛构成卡加延省卡拉延镇的达卢皮里村，2020 年人口 621 人（2010 年为 611 人），可从阿帕里港乘船前往。岛上有火山地貌和巴努阿湾的海滩，游客极少。
intro.en: Dalupiri Island lies in the Babuyan Islands in the Luzon Strait north of Luzon. The whole island makes up the barangay of Dalupiri in Calayan, Cagayan, which had 621 inhabitants in 2020, up from 611 in 2010, and it can be reached by boat from the Port of Aparri. Volcanic landforms and the beach at Banua Bay see very few visitors.

photo.commons: File:Landing Fields - Philippines - Dalupiri Island - NARA - 68160542.jpg
photo.author: Unknown authorUnknown author or not provided

intro.zh: 福琼岛是八打雁省的一座度假岛，面积 27 公顷，距纳苏格布海岸约 14 公里。岛上最出名的是模仿希腊神庙的白色柱廊遗迹，站在崖顶俯瞰蔚蓝海水格外上镜；岛边还有灯塔和适合浮潜的清澈海湾。
intro.en: Fortune Island is a resort island of Batangas province, 27 hectares in size and about 14 kilometres off the coast of Nasugbu. It is best known for its white Greek-style colonnade ruins perched on a cliff above the blue sea, a favourite photo spot, and it also has a lighthouse and clear coves for snorkelling.

intro.zh: 卡波内斯岛又名大卡蓬岛，长约 1.9 公里、最宽处约 0.4 公里，位于吕宋岛西岸三描礼士省外 3.8 公里，是卡波内斯群岛三座小岛中最大的一座。岛上遍布巨石和陡崖，四周是白沙和珊瑚滩，西端山坡上有卡波内斯岛灯塔，属圣安东尼奥镇蓬达基特村。
intro.en: Capones Island, also called Grand Capon, is about 1.9 kilometres long and 0.4 kilometres wide, lying 3.8 kilometres off the coast of Zambales on western Luzon. It is the largest of the three Capones Islands and belongs to barangay Pundaquit in San Antonio. Huge rock formations and steep cliffs rise above white sand and coral beaches, and the Capones Island Lighthouse stands on the hillside near its western end.

intro.zh: 卡瓦略岛（西班牙语意为“马岛”）是马尼拉湾入口处一座陡峭多岩的小岛，长约 1.2 公里，最高处 381 英尺。它和北面 2 公里外更大的科雷希多岛一起，把湾口分成南北两条深水航道。二战前全岛是美军的休斯堡要塞，战时遭到猛烈轰炸。
intro.en: Caballo Island, "Horse Island" in Spanish, is a bluff, rocky island at the entrance to Manila Bay, about 1.2 kilometres long and 381 feet high at its summit. Together with the larger Corregidor 2 kilometres to the north, it divides the mouth of the bay into the North and South channels. Before World War II the whole island was occupied by Fort Hughes, a US fortification that was heavily bombed during the war.

intro.zh: 阿利瓜伊岛是达皮丹市的一个村，全岛是已设立的海洋保护区，四周环绕着白沙滩和珊瑚礁。岛上没有淡水水源，只有少数居民，多以向游客卖鱼为生。这里是三宝颜北部潜水、浮潜和一日游的热门去处。
intro.en: Aliguay is an island and barangay of Dapitan and an established marine sanctuary, ringed by white sand beaches and coral reefs. There are no water sources on the island, and its few residents mostly sell fish to tourists. It is a popular spot for diving, snorkelling and day trips in Zamboanga del Norte.

name.zh: 阿利瓜伊岛保护景观与海景区

intro.zh: 阿利比哈班岛是吕宋岛邦多克半岛东南岸外、拉盖湾中的一个海岛村，属奎松省圣安德烈斯镇，2020 年人口 1,738 人。岛上以原始红树林、珊瑚礁、白沙滩和丰富的鸟类闻名，受国家保护区体系保护，保护范围达 1,056 公顷，周边 225 公顷海域为鱼类保护区。
intro.en: Alibijaban is an island barangay in Ragay Gulf off the southeastern coast of the Bondoc Peninsula, part of San Andres in Quezon province, with 1,738 people in 2020. It is known for pristine mangrove forest, coral reefs, white sandy beaches and rich birdlife, protected as a landscape and seascape of 1,056 hectares, with 225 hectares of surrounding water declared a fish sanctuary.

name.en: Saint Andrew the Apostle Parish Church

photo.commons: File:Alibijaban Island, San Andres, Quezon Province, Philippines (30).jpg
photo.author: Ian Wayne V. Dehayco

intro.zh: 潘关岛位于塔威塔威省锡唐凯镇，面积 0.06 平方公里，当地又叫 Malamanok——萨玛-巴瑶语意为“吃鸡”，因为前往沙巴的当地人常在此停下吃烤鸡。它是苏禄群岛中最靠近菲马边界的岛，距沙巴 50 公里，岛上有新建的军营、旗杆和一个小小的巴瑶族社区。
intro.en: Panguan Island lies in Sitangkai, Tawi-Tawi, and covers 0.06 square kilometres. It is also called Malamanok, "eat chicken" in Sama-Bajau, because locals travelling to Sabah stop here for roasted chicken. The last island of the Sulu Archipelago before the Malaysian border, 50 kilometres from Sabah, it has a new military barrack, a flagpole and a small Badjao community.

intro.zh: 白岛是卡米金岛曼巴豪北岸外约 1.4 公里的一座无人白沙洲，大致呈马蹄形，形状随潮汐不断变化。岛上没有树木，也没有任何遮蔽，只有一片纯白的沙；从沙洲上可以回望卡米金的希博克-希博克火山，是卡米金最受欢迎的景点之一。
intro.en: White Island is an uninhabited white sandbar about 1.4 kilometres off the northern shore of Mambajao on the volcanic island of Camiguin. Roughly horseshoe-shaped, it is constantly resized and reshaped by the tides. There are no trees or shelter of any kind, only pure white sand, and from it visitors look back at Camiguin's Mount Hibok-Hibok, making it one of the island's most popular sights.

intro.zh: 卡尼高岛是莱特省马塔隆镇外的一座小岛，周边渔场丰饶，珊瑚礁景色优美，适合潜水。岛上有灯塔和白沙滩，附近海域散布着以亚当、夏娃、该隐、亚伯命名的几处暗礁。
intro.en: Canigao is an islet off Matalom, Leyte, known for abundant fishing grounds and scenic coral reefs suitable for diving. It has a lighthouse and a white beach, and the nearby sea is scattered with reefs named after Adam, Eve, Cain and Abel.

intro.zh: 佩斯卡多尔岛当地叫 Agad-Agad，是塔尼翁海峡中的一座石灰岩小岛，离宿务岛西岸几公里，属莫阿尔博阿尔镇。岛名来自西班牙语“渔夫”，源于周边珊瑚礁鱼群丰富。岛周水下 5–10 米是覆盖软珊瑚的沙坡，之后是直落约 40 米的硬珊瑚墙，西侧还有被称为“大教堂”的开口水下洞穴。
intro.en: Pescador Island, locally called Agad-Agad, is a small limestone island in the Tañon Strait a few kilometres off the west coast of Cebu, under Moalboal. Its name means "fisherman" in Spanish, after the abundant fish on its reef. Underwater, a sandy slope of soft coral at 5–10 metres gives way to a wall of hard coral dropping to about 40 metres, and on the west side lies an open-top cave known as the Cathedral.

name.zh: 莫阿尔博阿尔沙丁鱼风暴潜点

intro.zh: 布格苏克岛是巴拉望省巴拉巴克镇的一座岛，面积约 119 平方公里，位于巴拉望最南端的群岛之中。周边散布着潘达南岛、加邦岛等小岛和多条白沙洲，海水清澈、人迹罕至，是巴拉望南部的原始海岛风景。
intro.en: Bugsuk is an island of Balabac municipality in Palawan, covering 119 square kilometres among the islands at the southern tip of Palawan. Islets such as Pandanan and Gabung and several white sandbars dot the clear, little-visited waters around it, offering the untouched island scenery of southern Palawan.

intro.zh: 迪奥戈岛当地叫 Di'nem 岛，是巴丹群岛省一座无人居住的火山岛。它是一块孤零零耸出海面的巨岩，四面都是陡峭悬崖，海流湍急，几乎无法登岸。这是一座已被海浪严重侵蚀的死火山，只能从伊特巴亚特岛远眺。
intro.en: Diogo Island, known locally as Di'nem Island, is an uninhabited volcanic island in Batanes, the northernmost province of the Philippines. A lone rock rising out of the sea with steep cliffs on every side, it is practically impossible to land on because of dangerous currents. It is an extinct volcano heavily eroded by the sea and is best viewed from Itbayat.
